summary: Introduced RoundTripFeePolicies as the explicit entry/exit policy product and FeeInclusivePnl as the pure staged scenario composition boundary. The initial identity gate accumulates round-trip and both policy mismatches before suppressing dependent work. Exact scenario price normalization and both assessment/conversion branches remain independently eligible; each successful assessment converts every fee through its centrally selected immutable slice market, and failures retain stable leg, directive, refined slice, and typed cause provenance. Successful results retain the round trip, both ScenarioFees values, and JVM-sealed attributed contributions while projecting all price, contribution, fee, and net totals from one core Pnl. Different policies, typed sum causes, no fees, charges, rebates, third assets, per-slice rates, multiple missing conversions, mixed policy/conversion failures, identity suppression, ordering, replay equality, and attribution visibility pass. Both formatting checks, all 38 fee-policy tests, and all 158 adversarial/compiler tests pass. The automated review completed scope, AC-016, staging, provenance, conversion, core ownership, JVM authority, dependency purity, complexity, security applicability, evidence, and checkpoint axes with no findings; its final pass changed no file, triaged no finding, and is not canonical whole-change Verify or Human Review.
